description: Sri Lanka Customs - Unaccompanied Passenger Baggage Bonded Warehouse - Customs Notification No. 3/2021
categorisation: This gazette notification establishes regulatory approval for customs warehouses under the Customs Ordinance, specifically designating bonded warehouses for unaccompanied passenger baggage. It falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it creates a regulatory framework and compliance requirements for customs operations, without involving government personnel changes, structural reorganization, or other specialized categories.
